title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
content: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children
content: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.

title: Potential Taiwan tension sparked 'last minute' change in Trump-Xi National Archives visit
content: The sudden change was precipitated because of Chinese displeasure over one document that the U.S. had planned to show.

title: This startup wants to prove gene-editing embryos is safe for making healthy babies
content: Origin Genomics aims to prove that the potential benefits of its technology for editing disease-causing genes in human embryos outweigh the risks.

title: This year's MacArthur Fellows include researchers who fuse science and justice
content: The MacArthur Foundation has just announced its latest batch of 20 fellows. Among the recipients of the $800,000 "no-strings-attached" fellowships are researchers who were recognized for their work at the intersection of science and justice.

title: Meet the 20 scholars and artists who've just won MacArthur Fellowships
content: A historian who studies wage gaps between races and a saxophonist whose live performances include a chef are among the latest recipients of the philanthropic group's annual, no-strings-attached $800,000 grants.

title: Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened
content: The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
content: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
content: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

title: Morning news brief
content: Five men arrested on terror charges near U.K. air base released on bail, Trump administration rolls back fuel efficiency standards for new vehicles, prosecutors reopen Cornell fraternity rape case.
